## Purpose
`/admin/users`: lists users, and invites new ones (with an initial workspace and role).

## Responsibilities
`UsersPage` reads `adminApi.users`. `InviteUserDialog` calls `createUser`, toasts "<name> invited", and shows the invite link. Titled "Users — Admin console".

## Key elements
`UsersPage`, `InviteUserDialog`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
User creation.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/admin/users`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- EmptyState and ErrorState.

## Nuances and gotchas
A user needs at least one workspace.

As described.

None.
